Keywords: The Reach (Heartland of the Rose Blackcrown)

Variants.Content: Blackcrown City is located on the southwest coast of the Reach, close to the navigation channel of the Shield Islands. Coastal castles in the Reach can't just rely on fertile fields, they also have to understand tides, reefs, docks and coastal warnings. The Shield Islands stood between shipping lanes and bays, protecting inland ports and putting the islanders at the forefront of pirates, ironborn, and ocean storms. Blackcrown City can profit from fishing, salt, shipping and agricultural exchange, while also undertaking the responsibility of observing the sea and communicating with neighboring lords. Its strategic value comes from the land-sea interface and archipelago routes, rather than the permanent stationing of a certain fleet.
Entry Blackcrown Local families also relied on grain, wine, orchards, pastures, and markets along the Mander River; if any road, well, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Blackcrown If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Blackcrown A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Blackcrown They care about grain, wine, orchards, pastures and markets along the Mander River. They also look at whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
